changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task to specific 'Open-domain Question Answering', normalized T5 model capitalization, and unified output descriptions to the most accurate description
Consolidated all Recall variants under single 'Recall' metric as per simplification guidelines; Exact Match is used as primary evaluation metric
No LLM judging was used in this paper; only automatic metrics and no LLM-based evaluation
No human evaluations were conducted in this paper; evaluation was purely automatic using Exact Match and Recall metrics

overall_notes: This paper presents YONO, a unified model for open-domain QA that integrates retrieval, reranking, and generation into a single architecture. The evaluation focuses exclusively on automatic metrics (Exact Match and Recall at various k values) without human evaluation or LLM-based judging. The paper is clearly an NLG paper as it generates answers to open-domain questions.
